scope: Emitted raw/optimized producer ownership and signal lifetime, C Wait/Poll and lost-IRQ timeout across wrap, coalesced completion before Wait under Forbid, native/emulation delivery, startup rollback, raw console cancellation/destruction/faults, and loaded same-image replay. Development checks only.
changes: No production code change in this slice.

Producer fixture now covers VBXE source 4 and rejects a mismatched prepared owner, both controller/recipient removal, active/released signal free, foreign Release/Drain and independent source retention.
C lost-source case suppresses only IRQ delivery, waits for EXPIRED through tick wrap, verifies real completed pixels, and then reuses the driver for new nonreused operation IDs.
Forbid fixture allows real IRQ completion before Wait and coalesces two more signals; exactly one durable result is consumed. The second operation completes in emulation context.
Occupied external timer prevents binding and rolls back the allocated signal without changing vectors.
Startup exhaustion fixture now tracks 64 allocations for the current 4 MiB pin instead of failing at its old 16-entry fixture capacity.
limits: Fault-stop park intentionally retains unquiesced storage; it is not a recoverable normal close.
The finite race cases establish these boundaries; they are not an exhaustive emulator/platform qualification matrix.
